theory PQS_Stream begin

// Function signature and definition of the equational theory E

builtins: diffie-hellman, natural-numbers
functions: adec/2, aenc/2, chain/2, fst/1, h/1, kdf/1, pair/2, pk/1,
           sdec/2, senc/2, sign/2, snd/1, true/0, verify/3
equations:
    adec(aenc(x.1, pk(x.2)), x.2) = x.1,
    fst(<x.1, x.2>) = x.1,
    sdec(senc(x.1, x.2), x.2) = x.1,
    snd(<x.1, x.2>) = x.2,
    verify(sign(x.1, x.2), x.1, pk(x.2)) = true

tactic: states_last
presort: s
prio: {id}
  regex"Fr\("
  regex"!LtkD\("
  regex"!KU\(~"
  regex"!KU\(sign"
deprio: {id}
  regex"!GSess\("
  regex"DSt\("
  regex"!KU\(senc"
  regex"!KU\(kdf"
  regex"!KU\(chain"

















restriction Equality:
  "∀ x y #i. (Eq( x, y ) @ #i) ⇒ (x = y)"
  // safety formula

restriction Unique:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((Uniq( x ) @ #i) ∧ (Uniq( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  // safety formula

restriction OneKeyG:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((KeyG( x ) @ #i) ∧ (KeyG( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  // safety formula

restriction OneKeyD:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((KeyD( x ) @ #i) ∧ (KeyD( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  // safety formula

rule (modulo E) G_Packet:
   [
   !GSess( D, G, th, ck0 ),
   In( <'D', th, %b, i, 
        senc(<m, 'D', th, %b, i>,
             kdf(<'pkt', kdf(<'batch', chain(ck0, %b)>), i>))
       >
   )
   ]
  --[ GAccept( D, G, th, %b, i, m ), Uniq( <'pkt', th, %b, i> ) ]->
   [
   !GGot( D, th, %b, i, m,
          h(<'leaf', th, %b, i, 
             h(<'kc', kdf(<'pkt', kdf(<'batch', chain(ck0, %b)>), i>)>), 
             senc(<m, 'D', th, %b, i>,
                  kdf(<'pkt', kdf(<'batch', chain(ck0, %b)>), i>))
            >)
   )
   ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) G_Disclose:
   [ !GSess( D, G, th, ck0 ), !GGot( D, th, %b, i, m, l ) ]
  --[ Disclose( th, %b, i ) ]->
   [ Out( kdf(<'pkt', kdf(<'batch', chain(ck0, %b)>), i>) ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

lemma dev_state_origin [reuse, use_induction]:
  all-traces
  "∀ D G th ck0 #a.
    (DStep( D, G, th, ck0 ) @ #a) ⇒
    (∃ #b. (DInit( D, G, th, ck0 ) @ #b) ∧ (#b < #a))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ D G th ck0 #a.
  (DStep( D, G, th, ck0 ) @ #a)
 ∧
  ∀ #b. (DInit( D, G, th, ck0 ) @ #b) ⇒ ¬(#b < #a)"
*/
induction
  case empty_trace
  by contradiction /* from formulas */
next
  case non_empty_trace
  simplify
  solve( (last(#a))  ∥
         (∃ #b. (DInit( D, G, th, ck0 ) @ #b) ∧ (¬(last(#b))) ∧ (#b < #a)) )
    case case_1
    solve( DStep( D, G, th, ck0 ) @ #a )
      case D_Batch
      solve( !LtkD( D, skD ) ▶₁ #a )
        case Device_Setup
        solve( DSt( $D, G, th, ck0, %b ) ▶₀ #a )
          case D_Batch
          by contradiction /* from formulas */
        next
          case D_Init
          by contradiction /* from formulas */
        next
          case D_RevState
          by contradiction /* from formulas */
        qed
      qed
    next
      case D_RevState
      solve( DSt( D, G, th, ck0, %b ) ▶₀ #a )
        case D_Batch
        by contradiction /* from formulas */
      next
        case D_Init
        by contradiction /* from formulas */
      next
        case D_RevState
        by contradiction /* from formulas */
      qed
    qed
  next
    case case_2
    by contradiction /* from formulas */
  qed
qed

lemma chain_key_index [reuse, use_induction]:
  all-traces
  "∀ x %b #a.
    (!KU( chain(x, %b) ) @ #a) ⇒
    ((∃ #c. (!KU( x ) @ #c) ∧ (#c < #a)) ∨
     (∃ %j #r.
       ((RevChainAt( x, %j ) @ #r) ∧ (#r < #a)) ∧ ((%j = %b) ∨ (%j ⊏ %b))))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ x %b #a.
  (!KU( chain(x, %b) ) @ #a)
 ∧
  (∀ #c. (!KU( x ) @ #c) ⇒ ¬(#c < #a)) ∧
  (∀ %j #r.
    (RevChainAt( x, %j ) @ #r)
   ⇒
    ((¬(#r < #a)) ∨ ((¬(%j = %b)) ∧ (¬(%j ⊏ %b)))))"
*/
induction
  case empty_trace
  by contradiction /* from formulas */
next
  case non_empty_trace
  simplify
  solve( (last(#a))  ∥
         (∃ #c. (!KU( x ) @ #c) ∧ (¬(last(#c))) ∧ (#c < #a))  ∥
         (∃ %j #r.
           (RevChainAt( x, %j ) @ #r)
          ∧
           (¬(last(#r))) ∧ (#r < #a) ∧ (((%j = %b) ∨ (%j ⊏ %b)))) )
    case case_1
    solve( !KU( chain(x, %b) ) @ #a )
      case Chain_Forward
      solve( (∃ #c. (!KU( x ) @ #c) ∧ (¬(last(#c))) ∧ (#c < #vk))  ∥
             (∃ %j #r.
               (RevChainAt( x, %j ) @ #r)
              ∧
               (¬(last(#r))) ∧ (#r < #vk) ∧ (((%j = %b) ∨ (%j ⊏ %b)))) )
        case case_1
        by contradiction /* from formulas */
      next
        case case_2
        by contradiction /* contradictory subterm store */
      qed
    next
      case D_Batch_case_1
      by solve( (#vr.2, 0) ~~> (#a, 0) )
    next
      case D_Batch_case_2
      by solve( (#vr.8, 0) ~~> (#a, 0) )
    next
      case D_Batch_case_3
      by solve( (#vr.2, 0) ~~> (#a, 0) )
    next
      case D_Batch_case_4
      by solve( (#vr.8, 0) ~~> (#a, 0) )
    next
      case D_Batch_case_5
      by solve( (#vr.2, 0) ~~> (#a, 0) )
    next
      case D_RevState
      by contradiction /* from formulas */
    next
      case c_chain
      by contradiction /* from formulas */
    qed
  next
    case case_2
    by contradiction /* from formulas */
  next
    case case_3
    by contradiction /* from formulas */
  qed
qed

lemma exec_loss [heuristic={states_last}]:
  exists-trace
  "∃ D G th m #s #a #d #i.
    ((((((((DSent( D, G, th, %1, '1', m ) @ #s) ∧
           (GAccept( D, G, th, %1, '1', m ) @ #a)) ∧
          (Disclose( th, %1, '1' ) @ #d)) ∧
         (Judge( D, th, %1, '1', m ) @ #i)) ∧
        (¬(∃ G2 m2 #j. GAccept( D, G2, th, %1, '2', m2 ) @ #j))) ∧
       (¬(∃ X #r. RevD( X ) @ #r))) ∧
      (¬(∃ X #r. QBreak( X ) @ #r))) ∧
     (¬(∃ X #r. KBreak( X ) @ #r))) ∧
    (¬(∃ x %j #r. RevChainAt( x, %j ) @ #r))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all satisfying traces:
"∃ D G th m #s #a #d #i.
  (DSent( D, G, th, %1, '1', m ) @ #s) ∧
  (GAccept( D, G, th, %1, '1', m ) @ #a) ∧
  (Disclose( th, %1, '1' ) @ #d) ∧
  (Judge( D, th, %1, '1', m ) @ #i)
 ∧
  (∀ G2 m2 #j. (GAccept( D, G2, th, %1, '2', m2 ) @ #j) ⇒ ⊥) ∧
  (∀ X #r. (RevD( X ) @ #r) ⇒ ⊥) ∧
  (∀ X #r. (QBreak( X ) @ #r) ⇒ ⊥) ∧
  (∀ X #r. (KBreak( X ) @ #r) ⇒ ⊥) ∧
  (∀ x %j #r. (RevChainAt( x, %j ) @ #r) ⇒ ⊥)"
*/
by sorry

lemma exec_judge [heuristic={states_last}]:
  exists-trace
  "∃ D G th m #s #d #i.
    ((((((DSent( D, G, th, %1, '2', m ) @ #s) ∧
         (Disclose( th, %1, '2' ) @ #d)) ∧
        (Judge( D, th, %1, '2', m ) @ #i)) ∧
       (¬(∃ X #r. RevD( X ) @ #r))) ∧
      (¬(∃ X #r. QBreak( X ) @ #r))) ∧
     (¬(∃ X #r. KBreak( X ) @ #r))) ∧
    (¬(∃ x %j #r. RevChainAt( x, %j ) @ #r))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all satisfying traces:
"∃ D G th m #s #d #i.
  (DSent( D, G, th, %1, '2', m ) @ #s) ∧
  (Disclose( th, %1, '2' ) @ #d) ∧
  (Judge( D, th, %1, '2', m ) @ #i)
 ∧
  (∀ X #r. (RevD( X ) @ #r) ⇒ ⊥) ∧
  (∀ X #r. (QBreak( X ) @ #r) ⇒ ⊥) ∧
  (∀ X #r. (KBreak( X ) @ #r) ⇒ ⊥) ∧
  (∀ x %j #r. (RevChainAt( x, %j ) @ #r) ⇒ ⊥)"
*/
simplify
solve( !GGot( D, th, %1, '2', m, l ) ▶₁ #d )
  case G_Packet
  solve( !KU( sign(<'init', 
                    h(<'th', sid, aenc(<'kem', s1>, pk(~skK)), E, pk(~skK), 'g'^~skX, 
                       pk(~skD)>)
                   >,
                   ~skD)
         ) @ #vk.15 )
    case D_Init
    solve( !KU( ~sid ) @ #vk.11 )
      case D_Init
      solve( DSent( D.1, G.2,
                    h(<'th', ~sid, aenc(<'kem', ~s1>, pk(~skK)), 'g'^~e, pk(~skK), 'g'^~skX, 
                       pk(~skD)>),
                    %1, '2', m.1
             ) @ #s )
        case D_Batch
        solve( !LtkD( $D, skD.1 ) ▶₁ #s )
          case Device_Setup
          solve( Judge( $D,
                        h(<'th', ~sid, aenc(<'kem', ~s1>, pk(~skK)), 'g'^~e, pk(~skK), 'g'^~skX, 
                           pk(~skD)>),
                        %1, '2', ~m2
                 ) @ #i )
            case Judge2
            solve( !KU( sign(<'batch', 
                              h(<'th', ~sid, aenc(<'kem', ~s1>, pk(~skK)), 'g'^~e, pk(~skK), 'g'^~skX, 
                                 pk(~skD)>), 
                              %1, 
                              h(<'node', 
                                 h(<'th', ~sid, aenc(<'kem', ~s1>, pk(~skK)), 'g'^~e, pk(~skK), 'g'^~skX, 
                                    pk(~skD)>), 
                                 %1, sib, 
                                 h(<'leaf', 
                                    h(<'th', ~sid, aenc(<'kem', ~s1>, pk(~skK)), 'g'^~e, pk(~skK), 'g'^~skX, 
                                       pk(~skD)>),
